zh: 我好像把护照落在房间的保险箱里了。
target: I think I left ... / I might have left ...
refs: I think I left my passport in the safe in my room.
I might have left my passport in the room safe.

variants.zh: 我好像把手机落在刚才那辆出租车上了。
refs: I think I left my phone in the taxi I just took.
I might have left my phone in that taxi.

variants.zh: 我好像把房卡落在餐厅里了。
refs: I think I left my key card in the restaurant.
I might have left my room key at the restaurant.

notes: “落在某处”用 leave，不用 forget；“好像”要译出来

zh: 这可能是因为反馈信号太弱，无法引导模型。
refs: This may be because the feedback signal is too weak to guide the model.
This is likely because the feedback signal is too weak to effectively guide the model.

variants.zh: 这可能是因为测试用例太少，没能覆盖边界情况。
refs: This may be because there are too few test cases to cover edge cases.
This may be due to the limited number of test cases, which fail to cover edge cases.

variants.zh: 这可能是因为模型缺乏针对特定硬件的知识。
refs: This may be because the model lacks hardware-specific knowledge.
This is likely because the model lacks knowledge specific to the target hardware.

notes: 论文里用 may / is likely，避免 maybe；太……无法 = too ... to

zh: 我的航班很早就到了，请问能不能提前入住？
refs: My flight got in early. Would it be possible to check in early?
My flight arrived quite early, so would it be possible to check in now?

variants.zh: 我的航班是晚上的，请问能不能晚点退房？
refs: My flight isn't until the evening. Would it be possible to check out late?
My flight's in the evening, so would it be possible to get a late checkout?

variants.zh: 房间外面有点吵，请问能不能换个房间？
refs: It's a bit noisy outside my room. Would it be possible to change rooms?
My room's a bit noisy. Would it be possible to switch to a different one?

notes: 避免 Can you help me to ... / Is there any possibility to ...

zh: 能否请审稿人具体说明对实验设置的顾虑？
refs: Could the reviewer clarify their specific concerns about the experimental setup?
We would appreciate it if the reviewer could elaborate on their concerns regarding the experimental setup.

variants.zh: 能否请审稿人指明是哪个实验结果不够清楚？
refs: Could the reviewer specify which experimental result is unclear?
Could the reviewer clarify which result they found unclear?

variants.zh: 能否请审稿人提供与这一点相关的参考文献？
refs: Could the reviewer point us to references related to this point?
Could the reviewer provide relevant references on this point?

notes: rebuttal 中请求审稿人时用第三人称 the reviewer，不用 you

zh: 账单上这个价格好像跟网上写的不一样。
refs: This price doesn't seem to match what it says online.
The price on the bill doesn't seem to match the one listed online.

variants.zh: 这个房价好像比我预订时高了一点。
refs: This rate seems a bit higher than what I booked.
The room rate seems slightly higher than when I booked.

variants.zh: 找给我的零钱好像少了十块。
refs: I think my change is ten short.
It looks like my change is ten short.

notes: 避免 is wrong / is different，太直接；不一样 = doesn't match

zh: 消融结果表明，反思模块对正确率很重要。
refs: The ablation results suggest that the reflection module is important for accuracy.
Our ablation results suggest that the reflection module plays an important role in accuracy.

variants.zh: 实验结果表明，更多的迭代有助于进一步提速。
refs: The experimental results suggest that more iterations lead to further speedups.
Our results suggest that additional iterations help achieve further speedups.

variants.zh: 这些结果表明，硬件反馈比代码示例更有用。
refs: These results suggest that hardware feedback is more useful than code examples.
These results suggest that hardware feedback is more helpful than code examples.

notes: suggest that 比 show that 更谨慎；module 不是 model；正确率 = accuracy

zh: 我明天早上六点要去机场，能帮我叫辆出租车吗？
refs: I need to get to the airport at 6 tomorrow morning. Could you book me a taxi?
I'm heading to the airport at 6 a.m. tomorrow. Could you call me a taxi?

variants.zh: 我的箱子有点重，能帮我把行李送到房间吗？
refs: My suitcase is pretty heavy. Could you have it brought up to my room?
My bag is a bit heavy. Could you bring it up to my room, please?

variants.zh: 我的手机没电了，能帮我打印一下登机牌吗？
refs: My phone's dead. Could you print my boarding pass for me?
My phone's out of battery. Could you print out my boarding pass?

notes: “帮我做某事”不必译成 help me，直接 Could you + 动词

zh: 你介意把复现实验的代码发给我看看吗？
refs: Would you mind sending me the code for reproducing the experiments?
Would you mind sharing your reproduction code with me?

variants.zh: 你介意帮我看一下这个 kernel 为什么这么慢吗？
refs: Would you mind taking a look at why this kernel is so slow?
Would you mind looking into why this kernel is running so slowly?

variants.zh: 你介意在投稿前帮我改一下摘要吗？
refs: Would you mind revising the abstract for me before we submit?
Would you mind polishing the abstract before submission?

notes: mind 后面接 -ing；复现 = reproduce

zh: 天气不好，我的航班可能会延误一两个小时。
refs: The weather's bad, so my flight might be delayed an hour or two.
My flight might be delayed by an hour or two because of the weather.

variants.zh: 前一班晚点了，我们可能会错过转机。
refs: Our first flight is running late, so we might miss our connection.
We might miss our connecting flight because the first one is late.

variants.zh: 现在是旺季，市中心的酒店可能都订满了。
refs: It's peak season, so the hotels downtown might all be booked up.
Since it's peak season, the hotels in the city center might be fully booked.

notes: 转机 = connecting flight；订满 = fully booked / booked up

zh: 我们的方法可能也适用于 AMD 以外的其他硬件。
target: may also apply to / generalize to
refs: Our approach may also apply to hardware beyond AMD.
Our method may also generalize to non-AMD hardware.

variants.zh: 这个结论可能也适用于用 CUDA 编写的 kernel。
refs: This finding may also apply to kernels written in CUDA.
This conclusion may also hold for CUDA kernels.

variants.zh: 该框架可能也适用于其他 GPU 编程语言。
refs: This framework may also apply to other GPU programming languages.
This framework may also extend to other GPU programming languages.

notes: 适用于 = apply to / hold for / extend to；以外 = beyond

zh: 我已经退房了，能把行李在这儿寄存到下午吗？
refs: I've already checked out. Could I leave my luggage here until this afternoon?
I've checked out already. Could I leave my bags here until the afternoon?

variants.zh: 我忘带充电器了，能跟你们借一个吗？
refs: I forgot my charger. Could I borrow one?
I forgot to bring my charger. Could I borrow one from you?

variants.zh: 订房之前，我能先看一下房间吗？
refs: Before I book, could I take a look at the room?
Could I see the room first before I book?

notes: 寄存行李 = leave my luggage，不用 store / deposit

zh: 实验还没跑完，能不能把截止日期推后几天？
refs: The experiments haven't finished yet. Would it be possible to extend the deadline by a few days?
Our experiments are still running. Would it be possible to push the deadline back a few days?

variants.zh: 我周四要出差，能不能把组会改到周五？
refs: I'm traveling on Thursday. Would it be possible to move the group meeting to Friday?
I'll be away on Thursday, so would it be possible to reschedule the meeting to Friday?

variants.zh: 我们的显卡不够用，能不能借用一下你们的集群？
refs: We don't have enough GPUs. Would it be possible to use your cluster for a while?
We're short on GPUs. Would it be possible to borrow some time on your cluster?

notes: 推迟截止日期 = extend / push back the deadline

zh: 我等了半个多小时，行李好像还没出来。
target: doesn't seem to have + 过去分词 / It looks like ...
refs: I've been waiting for over half an hour, and my luggage doesn't seem to have come out yet.
I've been waiting for more than 30 minutes, and it looks like my bag still hasn't come out.

variants.zh: 已经过去一周了，我的退款好像还没到账。
refs: It's been a week, and my refund doesn't seem to have come through yet.
It's been a week, and it looks like my refund still hasn't gone through.

variants.zh: 我昨天就付了钱，但预订好像还没确认。
refs: I paid yesterday, but my booking doesn't seem to have been confirmed yet.
I paid yesterday, but it looks like my reservation still hasn't been confirmed.

notes: “还没”要用完成体；等了多久用 have been waiting；到账 = come through

zh: 与基线方法相比，GEAK 往往能生成更快的 kernel。
refs: Compared with the baselines, GEAK tends to generate faster kernels.
GEAK tends to produce faster kernels than the baselines.

variants.zh: 在大规模输入上，更多的迭代往往带来更大的提速。
refs: On large inputs, more iterations tend to yield larger speedups.
For large inputs, additional iterations tend to bring greater speedups.

variants.zh: 访存模式规则的算子往往更容易优化。
refs: Operators with regular memory access patterns tend to be easier to optimize.
Operators with regular memory access tend to be easier to optimize.

notes: “往往”= tend to / often，不要漏译；基线 = baselines

zh: 您介意帮我们拍张照吗？把后面的塔也拍进去。
refs: Would you mind taking a photo of us, with the tower in the background?
Would you mind taking our picture? Could you get the tower in too?

variants.zh: 我想和朋友坐在一起，您介意和我换个座位吗？
refs: I'd like to sit with my friend. Would you mind switching seats with me?
Would you mind swapping seats with me so I can sit with my friend?

variants.zh: 我们明天要早起，您介意把音乐关小一点吗？
refs: We have to get up early tomorrow. Would you mind turning the music down a bit?
We've got an early start tomorrow. Would you mind turning the music down a little?

notes: mind 后面接 -ing，不接 to do；背景里有 = in the background

zh: 审稿人要求补充结果，你能在 H100 上再跑一遍吗？
refs: The reviewers asked for more results. Could you rerun the experiments on an H100?
A reviewer requested additional results. Could you run the experiments again on H100?

variants.zh: 为了方便对比，你能把结果整理成一张表吗？
refs: To make comparison easier, could you put the results into a single table?
Could you organize the results into one table so they're easier to compare?

variants.zh: 为了回应审稿人，你能补一组消融实验吗？
refs: To address the reviewer's comment, could you add an ablation study?
Could you run an additional ablation to address the reviewer's concern?

notes: 再跑一遍 = rerun；消融实验 = ablation study；回应审稿人 = address the reviewer's comment

zh: 路上有点堵，我们可能要晚一个小时才能到酒店。
refs: Traffic's a bit heavy, so we'll probably get to the hotel about an hour late.
We're stuck in traffic, so we'll probably be about an hour late getting to the hotel.

variants.zh: 明天的航班很晚，我们可能需要晚一点退房。
refs: Our flight tomorrow is pretty late, so we'll probably need a late checkout.
We'll probably need to check out late, since our flight tomorrow isn't until the evening.

variants.zh: 签证还没下来，我可能得把航班改到下周。
refs: My visa hasn't come through yet, so I'll probably have to move my flight to next week.
I'll probably need to rebook my flight for next week, since my visa still isn't ready.

notes: 到酒店用 get to / arrive at，不用 arrive to

zh: 根据 profiling 结果，提速似乎主要来自内存优化。
refs: Based on the profiling results, the speedup appears to come mainly from memory optimizations.
According to the profiling results, the speedup appears to stem primarily from memory optimizations.

variants.zh: 从日志来看，大部分错误似乎出在编译阶段。
refs: Judging from the logs, most errors appear to occur during compilation.
Based on the logs, most failures appear to stem from the compilation stage.

variants.zh: 与卷积相比，模型似乎更擅长优化矩阵乘法。
refs: The model appears to be better at optimizing matrix multiplication than convolution.
Compared with convolution, the model appears to perform better on matrix multiplication.

notes: 似乎 = appears to / seems to；来自 = come from / stem from

zh: 我想问一下能不能换个靠窗的座位，最好靠前一点。
target: I was wondering if I could ...
refs: I was wondering if I could get a window seat, preferably near the front.
I was wondering if I could switch to a window seat, ideally toward the front.

variants.zh: 我想问一下能不能升舱，大概要补多少钱。
refs: I was wondering if I could get an upgrade, and roughly how much it would cost.
I was wondering if an upgrade is possible, and what the extra cost would be.

variants.zh: 我想问一下房费里是不是包含两个人的早餐。
refs: I was wondering if breakfast for two is included in the rate.
I was wondering whether the rate includes breakfast for two.

notes: 升舱 = upgrade，不是 promotion；最好 = preferably / ideally

zh: 我想问一下，我们能否在论文中使用你们的 benchmark。
refs: I was wondering if we could use your benchmark in our paper.
I was wondering whether we might use your benchmark in our paper.

variants.zh: 我想问一下，能否在论文中引用你们未发表的结果。
refs: I was wondering if we could cite your unpublished results in our paper.
I was wondering whether we might cite your unpublished results in our paper.

variants.zh: 我想问一下，你们是否打算在论文发表后开源代码。
refs: I was wondering if you plan to release the code after the paper is published.
I was wondering whether you'll be open-sourcing the code once the paper is out.

notes: was wondering 后面的从句用陈述语序，不倒装
